commands: NODE=node-4 LAB_SRC=<engine worktree inkling2-loop-dense> OPS_LINES=500 scripts/ops_dev.sh test inkling2_ops mini_
NODE=node-4 LAB_SRC=<engine worktree inkling2-loop-dense> OPS_LINES=500 scripts/ops_dev.sh run inkling2_ops ''

oracle/.venv/bin/python testdata/inkling2_loop/gpu/gen_goldens.py --oracle oracle --out testdata/inkling2_loop/gpu   (engine worktree, the Mac, HTTP range reads of the pinned pack)
REXL3_NO_CUDA=1 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 cargo check -p gb-cuda --tests --locked   (the Mac)
REXL3_NO_CUDA=1 cargo test -p gb-model --lib --locked families::inkling2::   (the Mac: 31 passed)
notes: Timings are of one call on random 6-bit weights (L2 is warm across calls; the small tensors fit L2, so their GB/s is not a DRAM figure). The inkling2_ops run with an empty filter includes the Small's own tests (15 of them besides the Mini's 13; the golden-hash test among them); the real-Small-weights test and the dspark tests that need REXL3_INKLING2_DIR report 'not run' on this node (the Small's pack is not staged here and is not touched).
